deploy.startCommand: node scripts/preflight.mjs && npx prisma migrate deploy && echo '>>> migrations applied' && (timeout 120 npx prisma db seed || echo '>>> seed skipped (failed or timed out)') && echo ">>> launching web server on 0.0.0.0:${PORT:-3000}" && node_modules/.bin/next start -H 0.0.0.0 -p ${PORT:-3000}
